prompt: In which month and year did the COVID-19 toll across the world reach 1 million deaths, a number equivalent to the population of San Jose, California — the tenth largest city in the U.S. at that time?
answer:
The **worldwide COVID-19 death toll reached 1 million in September 2020**—specifically, on September 29–30.  

The comparison to San Jose, California, refers separately to the **U.S. reaching 1 million deaths in May 2022**.
